fieldNotes.siteIdentification: Confirmed via web search: 9401 Granite Way, Davenport IA 52806, Eastern Iowa Industrial Center, 382,000 sq ft Oscar Mayer Deli Fresh / Lunchables meat-processing plant on 70 acres (Gray Construction, 2017). The given lat/lng (41.6154, -90.6125) was ~300 m WSW of the building center; locked center to ~41.6160, -90.6105.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Single controlled entry off Slopertown Road at NW corner of employee parking. Property is fully enclosed by chain-link perimeter fence (confirmed on west, north, and east faces via Street View 2025-06). No barrier-arm visible from satellite but the fenced single-entrance pinch-point qualifies as a truck gate per rubric.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No standalone staffed guard booth visible at the road entry or anywhere along the truck route in z19-z21 satellite imagery. Small structure at SW corner of parking lot is HVAC/equipment, not a guard booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Modern 2017 greenfield Kraft Heinz plant; absence of visible guard booth in satellite imagery strongly implies remote kiosk / driver app check-in. Marked uncertain since the device itself is below satellite resolution.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Truck route passes through a wide paved apron south of parking before reaching dock face — provides queue/staging room (postGateStaging true).
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Driveway from public road entry to dock face is roughly 350 m (~1100 ft) of paved internal route — easily holds 3+ trucks in queue.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Counted ~40 dock doors along south face (split into west and east sub-banks) plus ~15-20 doors along east face facing the east drop yard. Total ~55-60. Band: 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: East-side drop yard holds ~50 parked trailers in marked stalls; south-side drop yard holds ~25 trailers. 75+ trailers visible, parking capacity ~110. Band: 50+.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically distinct dock clusters on different building faces: south-facing dock bank (long bank of ~40 doors) and east-facing dock bank (~20 doors with separate east drop yard) — consistent with separate shipping and receiving.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The driveway from Slopertown to the property has wide paved apron width and unused grass median on either side — physical room for a bypass/express lane addition.
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail mainline (3 tracks) runs N-S between Kraft Heinz and east-DC neighbor, with rail crossing on Slopertown. NO rail spur visible curving into Kraft Heinz property. Rail spur serves the east-DC, not Kraft Heinz.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: Main 382,000 sq ft manufacturing building (single complex). Secondary structure: wastewater treatment building at south of property (small). Counted as 2.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Surrounded by cornfields on north, west, and south; in the Eastern Iowa Industrial Center far north of Davenport's urban fabric. Clearly Rural.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: Rural but located within an active industrial park with multiple modern tenants and ~15 km from downtown Davenport — cellular coverage almost certainly good. Marked false with low concern.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale platform identified in satellite imagery along the inbound route or dock aprons — meat processing facilities can have a scale but I do not see one clearly. Marked uncertain.
fieldNotes.multiStep: Single gate/entry; no visible second checkpoint or scale house after entry. Marked false.
fieldNotes.approachUsed: Street View captured 2025-06 from Slopertown Road (north), Hillandale Drive (west), and the east intersection at the rail crossing; satellite at z17-z21 from Maxar 2026 imagery.
